FWR: Fire-Weather Regions

Parameters

years <- 1970:2021
lonLim <- c(-9.5, 4.3)
latLim <- c(36, 44)
dataset <- "ERA5"

Library

source("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/R2/load_data.R")
library(visualizeR)
devtools::load_all("/lustre/gmeteo/WORK/urrutxuai/test/transformeR") # instead of library(transformeR)

PCA

# ISI
dat_era_isi <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "ISI", dataset = dataset)
## [2026-05-28 09:42:26.819029] Defining geo-location parameters
## [2026-05-28 09:42:26.936377] Defining time selection parameters
## [2026-05-28 09:42:27.453966] Retrieving data subset ...
## [2026-05-28 09:44:48.572705] Done
clim <- climatology(dat_era_isi)
## [2026-05-28 09:44:53.812] - Computing climatology...
## [2026-05-28 09:44:57.3726] - Done.
# BUI
dat_era_bui <- load_data(year = years, lonLim = lonLim, latLim = latLim, what = "BUI", dataset = dataset)
## [2026-05-28 09:44:57.609721] Defining geo-location parameters
## [2026-05-28 09:44:57.663048] Defining time selection parameters
## [2026-05-28 09:44:57.914812] Retrieving data subset ...
## [2026-05-28 09:47:13.962378] Done
# convert to ("time", "point")
data_isi <- array(dat_era_isi$Data, dim = c(dim(dat_era_isi$Data)[1], prod(dim(dat_era_isi$Data)[-1])))
data_bui <- array(dat_era_bui$Data, dim = c(dim(dat_era_bui$Data)[1], prod(dim(dat_era_bui$Data)[-1])))

rm(dat_era_isi)
rm(dat_era_bui)

keep_points <- which(colSums(is.na(data_isi)) == 0)
data_isi <- t(data_isi[, keep_points])
data_bui <- t(data_bui[, keep_points])

# scale data
data_isi <- scale(data_isi)
data_bui <- scale(data_bui)

# combine ISI and BUI
data_combined <- cbind(data_isi, data_bui)

# compute PCA
pca_combined <- prcomp(data_combined, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

rm(data_isi)
rm(data_bui)
rm(data_combined)

pca_combined_var <- pca_combined$sdev^2
pca_combined_var_explained <- pca_combined_var / sum(pca_combined_var)
cumulative_var_explained <- cumsum(pca_combined_var_explained)
num_components <- which(cumulative_var_explained >= 0.95)[1]
pca_combined_reduced <- pca_combined$x[, 1:num_components]
num_components
## [1] 111
score_k <- numeric(9)
par(mfrow = c(3, 3))
for (k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  kmeans_combined <- kmeans(pca_combined_reduced, centers = k, nstart = 25)

  # add NA values for the removed points
  kmeans_combined$cluster_full <- rep(NA, prod(dim(clim$Data)[-1]))
  kmeans_combined$cluster_full[keep_points] <- kmeans_combined$cluster
  reshaped <- array(kmeans_combined$cluster_full, dim = dim(clim$Data)[-1])

  clim$Data[1,,] <- reshaped

  print(spatialPlot(clim, backdrop.theme = "countries", main = paste("Clusters of ISI and BUI with k =", k)))

  score_k[k-1] <- kmeans_combined$tot.withinss
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

plot(2:10, score_k, type = "b", xlab = "Number of Clusters (k)", ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares")
